content.title: Five priorities will determine the H2 outcome
content.subtitle: Actions agreed at the Q2 operating review
bulletPoints: Enterprise coverage: add dedicated account leadership across the ten largest North American opportunities
Product adoption: move role-based dashboards and saved views into every renewal success plan
Implementation speed: reduce median onboarding time from twelve weeks to eight
Customer assurance: close the remaining high-priority reliability actions before September renewals
Partner channel: publish the enablement package and certify the first six regional partners
prose: Each priority has an executive owner and will be reviewed against leading indicators every two weeks.
